description: Verify PostgreSQL database service is running and healthy
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep postgres

description: Verify Redis cache service is running and healthy
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep redis
Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_redis) redis-cli ping

description: Verify API service is running without health check failures
Verify UI service is running and accessible
Verify Nginx reverse proxy is running
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep nginx

description: Verify Celery worker service is running
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep celery-worker
Verify Current State is Running (not Complete or Shutdown)

description: Verify Celery beat scheduler is running
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep celery-beat

description: Verify Flower monitoring service is running
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep flower

description: Verify NATS service is either running or gracefully handled
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep nats
If NATS exists, verify it's running
If NATS doesn't exist, check API logs for graceful NATS fallback
Verify API doesn't crash due to NATS connection

description: Verify funnel-automation service is running without crashes
steps: Run: docker service ls | grep funnel-automation
Verify no crash loop (exit 1) or ModuleNotFoundError for aiohttp

description: Verify PostgreSQL database accepts connections
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_postgres) psql -U trading_user -d trading_db -c 'SELECT 1'

description: Verify database has core tables created
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_postgres) psql -U trading_user -d trading_db -c '\dt'
Verify tables exist: users, accounts, positions, trades, signals
Verify tables exist: api_keys, strategies, account_strategies, webhook_logs

description: Verify Redis is accessible from API container
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_api) python -c "import redis; r=redis.from_url('redis://redis:6379/0'); print(r.ping())"

description: Verify Docker overlay network exists and is attachable
steps: Run: docker network ls | grep trading_unified-network
Verify network exists with overlay driver

description: Verify main health endpoint is accessible and returns healthy status
Verify healthz endpoint for Kubernetes-style health checks
steps: Verify response indicates service is ready

description: Verify detailed status endpoint
Verify OpenAPI documentation is accessible
steps: Verify Swagger UI loads with API endpoints

description: Verify ReDoc documentation is accessible
Verify OpenAPI JSON schema is accessible
Verify CORS headers are properly configured
Verify API is accessible through Nginx reverse proxy
steps: Verify Nginx proxies request to trading_api:8000

description: Verify user registration endpoint is functional
steps: Verify response contains user object or success message

description: Verify user login endpoint returns JWT token
steps: Create test user via registration endpoint
Verify token is valid JWT format

description: Verify JWT token authentication works for protected endpoints
steps: Obtain JWT token from login endpoint

description: Verify token refresh endpoint extends session
steps: Verify new token has extended expiration

description: Verify logout endpoint invalidates session
steps: Attempt to use token on protected endpoint

description: Verify protected endpoints reject requests without authentication
steps: Verify error message indicates missing authentication

description: Verify API key generation creates valid keys
steps: Verify key is hashed in database

description: Verify API key can be used for authentication
steps: Verify API key authentication works as alternative to JWT

description: Verify MT4 broker executor is initialized
steps: Check API logs for MT4 initialization success

description: Verify MT5 broker executor is initialized
steps: Verify 'mt5' is true in brokers object
Check API logs for MT5 initialization success

description: Verify TradeLocker broker executor is configured and healthy
Verify TradeLocker SDK is present and functional
steps: Verify SDK can be imported in Python

description: Verify Tradovate broker executor is initialized
steps: Verify 'tradovate' is true in brokers object
Check API logs for Tradovate initialization

description: Verify ProjectX broker executor is initialized
steps: Verify 'projectx' is true in brokers object
Check API logs for ProjectX initialization

description: Verify broker account creation endpoint works
steps: Run: curl -X POST http://192.168.1.254:3012/api/v1/accounts -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"broker":"mt5","account_id":"12345","credentials":{...}}'
Verify account is created in database

description: Verify broker account listing endpoint returns accounts
Verify signal creation endpoint accepts trading signals
steps: Run: curl -X POST http://192.168.1.254:3012/api/v1/signals -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"symbol":"EURUSD","action":"buy","quantity":1}'
Verify signal is created in database

description: Verify signal execution processes trading signals
steps: Verify signal status changes to executed

description: Verify signal history endpoint returns past signals
steps: Verify list contains all created signals
Verify signals are ordered by timestamp

description: Verify open positions endpoint lists active positions
Verify position close endpoint closes positions
steps: Verify position status changes to closed

description: Verify trade history endpoint returns completed trades
steps: Execute and close position to create trade

description: Verify order management endpoint handles pending orders
Verify TradingView webhook receiver accepts alerts
steps: Verify webhook is logged in webhook_logs table
Verify signal is created from webhook

description: Verify TrailHacker webhook receiver accepts signals
Verify webhook logs are stored and retrievable
steps: Verify log contains request payload and timestamp

description: Verify webhook endpoints validate payload format
steps: Verify error message describes validation failure

description: Verify strategy registry lists available strategies
steps: Verify each strategy has name, version, description

description: Verify strategy can be enabled for account
steps: Verify strategy is marked as enabled

description: Verify strategy can be disabled for account
steps: Verify strategy is marked as disabled

description: Verify manual strategy execution endpoint runs strategy
steps: Verify trades are created if conditions met

description: Verify strategy statistics endpoint returns performance metrics
steps: Verify stats include: total_trades, win_rate, total_pnl, avg_pnl

description: Verify Celery worker processes tasks from queue
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=celery-worker) celery -A app.tasks.celery_app inspect active
Verify task appears in active or completed tasks

description: Verify Celery beat scheduler is scheduling periodic tasks
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=celery-beat) celery -A app.tasks.celery_app inspect scheduled
Verify scheduled tasks list is returned
Verify periodic tasks are scheduled (strategy execution, health checks)

description: Verify Flower monitoring UI is accessible
Verify periodic strategy execution runs on schedule
steps: Enable periodic strategy execution via endpoint
Wait for configured interval (check Celery beat logs)
Verify tasks appear in Flower dashboard

description: Verify React frontend loads without errors
steps: Verify no 404 errors for static assets

description: Verify frontend routing works for all pages
steps: Verify SPA routing works without page reloads

description: Verify login page renders and submits credentials
steps: Open Network tab, verify POST to /api/v1/auth/login

description: Verify dashboard page loads and displays data
steps: Verify API calls are made to fetch data
Verify data is displayed in UI (accounts, positions, trades)

description: Verify broker connection flow works in UI
Verify positions page displays open positions
steps: Login to UI and navigate to /positions
Verify positions table or list renders

description: Verify frontend API client is configured with correct base URL
steps: Trigger any API call (login, fetch data)
Verify request URL starts with http://192.168.1.254:3012 or correct API URL
Verify requests are not going to localhost:3012

description: Verify authentication flow works end-to-end
steps: Verify JWT token is stored (localStorage or cookie)
Verify subsequent API calls include Authorization header

description: Verify dashboard fetches live data from backend
steps: Verify responses contain real data (not mocks)
Verify data is rendered in UI

description: Verify broker account creation from UI creates backend record
steps: Verify POST to /api/v1/accounts in Network tab
Query database for created account record
Verify account exists in database with correct data

description: Verify WebSocket endpoint accepts connections
steps: Send test message and verify no errors

description: Verify WebSocket sends position updates in real-time
steps: In another terminal, execute signal to create position
Verify WebSocket receives message about new position

description: Verify frontend UI updates in real-time via WebSocket
steps: Login to UI and navigate to positions page
Open browser console to check WebSocket connection
Execute signal via API or webhook
Verify positions page updates without refresh
Verify WebSocket message is logged in console

description: Verify Alembic migrations are applied to database
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_api) alembic current

description: Verify api_keys table exists with correct schema
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_postgres) psql -U trading_user -d trading_db -c '\d api_keys'
Verify columns: id, user_id, name, key_hash, created_at, revoked_at

description: Verify strategies table exists with correct schema
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_postgres) psql -U trading_user -d trading_db -c '\d strategies'
Verify columns: id, name, version, description, source_code, created_at

description: Verify account_strategies table exists for strategy enable/disable
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_postgres) psql -U trading_user -d trading_db -c '\d account_strategies'
Verify columns: id, account_id, strategy_id, enabled, created_at

description: Verify database INSERT operations work
steps: Create test user via registration endpoint
Query database: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email='test@test.com'

description: Verify database SELECT queries return correct data
steps: Create test data via API endpoints
Compare API response with direct database query

description: Verify database UPDATE operations work
Verify database DELETE operations work
steps: Verify record is removed or soft-deleted

description: Verify Flower dashboard shows worker statistics
steps: Verify worker stats: active, completed, failed tasks

description: Verify application logs are accessible and structured
steps: Verify log level, timestamp, message format
Check for no excessive ERROR or WARNING messages

description: Verify Prometheus metrics endpoint exposes metrics
steps: Verify metrics include: request_count, request_duration, etc.

description: Verify API returns 400 Bad Request for invalid payloads
steps: Verify error message describes validation failure

description: Verify API returns 401 Unauthorized for missing token
steps: Verify error message: 'Not authenticated' or similar

description: Verify API returns 404 Not Found for non-existent resources
steps: Verify error message indicates resource not found

description: Verify API returns 500 Internal Server Error gracefully
steps: Verify error message doesn't expose sensitive details
Verify error is logged for debugging

description: Verify application continues to function if NATS is unavailable
steps: Check API logs for NATS connection messages
If NATS connection fails, verify API still starts
Verify events are logged instead of sent to NATS
Verify no crash or startup failure due to NATS

description: Verify user passwords are hashed with bcrypt
steps: Query database: SELECT password FROM users WHERE email='test@test.com'
Verify password field contains bcrypt hash (starts with $2b$)
Verify password is not stored in plaintext

description: Verify API keys are hashed before storage
steps: Query database: SELECT key_hash FROM api_keys
Verify plaintext key is not in database

description: Verify JWT tokens are signed with secret key
steps: Decode JWT header (don't verify signature yet)
Attempt to create fake token with different secret
Verify fake token is rejected by API

description: Verify sensitive endpoints enforce HTTPS (if configured)
steps: Check nginx configuration for HTTPS redirect
Attempt to access sensitive endpoint via HTTP
Verify redirect to HTTPS or secure headers present
Verify no sensitive data in HTTP responses if HTTPS not configured

description: Verify .env file is not committed to git and contains secrets
steps: Verify SECRET_KEY, database passwords are in .env

description: Verify CORS only allows specific origins
steps: Verify only trusted origins are allowed

description: Verify aiohttp is added to requirements.txt
steps: Verify aiohttp==3.9.1 or similar is present
Verify no ModuleNotFoundError for aiohttp in logs

description: Verify all required packages are in requirements.txt
steps: Run: docker exec -it $(docker ps -q -f name=trading_api) pip list
Verify key packages installed: fastapi, sqlalchemy, redis, celery, pydantic

description: Verify API Docker image builds without errors
steps: Verify no build errors or warnings

description: Verify UI Docker image builds without errors
steps: Run: cd ui && docker build -t test-ui .

description: Verify Docker stack deploys all services
steps: Run: docker stack deploy -c docker-stack.yml trading
Wait 60 seconds for services to start
Run: docker service ls | grep trading
Verify all services show 1/1 or 2/2 replicas (not 0/1)

description: Execute complete trade flow: signal creation to position close
steps: Verify trade appears in /api/v1/trades with P&L

steps: Verify signal is created from webhook
Verify signal auto-executes or is ready for execution
Verify position is opened on broker

steps: Verify trades are created if conditions met
